A1.justification: Both complete 36-page PDFs contain the same research paper and Appendices A–J. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical content apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original Stable Diffusion finetuning experiments, numerical comparisons, ablations and generated-image examples in Section 4, Table 1 and Appendices E–J.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experimental results, including Table 1, convergence and trade-off plots, ablations and qualitative image comparisons.

M1.justification: The ∇-DB and residual ∇-DB objectives, forward-looking parameterization and Algorithm 1 are identical. The methodological extensions in the appendices are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same text-to-image alignment tasks using Aesthetic Score, HPSv2 and ImageReward, including the animal prompts, HPDv2 photo/painting prompts and appendix examples.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the base-model reference and DDPO, ReFL, DRaFT-1, DRaFT-LV, DAG-DB and residual DB comparisons. Comparator membership in the individual appendix experiments also matches.

E3.justification: The Stable Diffusion v1.5 setup, 50-step DDPM sampler, 200-update budget, checkpoint selection and reward, DreamSim and FID metrics are unchanged. The 20-step SDE-DPM-Solver++ experiment is present identically in both.

E4.justification: Section 4.4 and Appendices E–J retain identical timing analyses, qualitative comparisons and ablations of temperature, subsampling, reward attenuation, sampler choice, prior strength and second-order gradients.

E5.justification: Both report three random seeds in Section 4.3 and the same means, standard deviations and graphical uncertainty reporting. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Every Table 1 entry and all plotted results and qualitative samples match, including Appendices E–J. No numerical values, rankings, trends or result entries are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: Propositions 1 and 4, their Appendix B proofs, the divergence and trajectory-balance derivations, and the additional equations in Appendices C and G are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty claims for gradient-informed GFlowNets and the same claimed trade-off between finetuning speed, diversity and prior preservation.

C2.justification: The interpretations of convergence, diversity, prior preservation and ablation outcomes are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same qualification concerning bias from non-ideal pretrained models.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information matches, including LoRA rank, learning rates, regularization, sampling details and the eight-A100 timing setup. Project-access information and embedded link targets are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5, the reference list and comparisons with earlier GFlowNet and diffusion-alignment research are identical. No cited work or research-positioning claim changes.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v2 / 6 Mar 2025 to v3 / 6 Apr 2025. This is a minor administrative text update; prose, terminology, headings and document structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Table 1, all 31 figures, captions, equations and page layouts are unchanged. Pages 2–36 render identically; first-page visual differences are confined to the updated arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information and presentation are identical across both PDFs, including every appendix. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp does not improve or diminish the paper's overall quality.
